The '''Ancathia system''' was located in the [[Albarrio sector/Legends|Albarrio sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Ancathian funge-flower]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]].<ref name="Spero" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ancathia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-5.<ref name="TEA" />
